The formula for the derivative of $arccsc$ is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(arccsc\,x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{{x}^{2}-1}}.
$$

Using the chain rule and the formula above, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[arccsc(\sqrt{x})] \\  & =-\frac{1}{|\sqrt{x}|\sqrt{{(\sqrt{x})}^{2}-1}}\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\sqrt{x}) \\  & =-\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}\sqrt{x-1}}\cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{2x\sqrt{x-1}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the slope $m$ of the tangent line to the curve at $x=2$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}m={f}^{′}(2) & =-\frac{1}{2\cdot 2\sqrt{2-1}} \\  & =-\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
